gloss: independent travel; individual travel; traveling on one's own

definitions.gloss: independent travel; individual travel; non-group travel
definitions.explanation: Travel arranged and undertaken by an individual or small group independently, as opposed to organized group tours. The traveler plans their own itinerary, transportation, and accommodation.

examples.japanese: {個人|こじん}{旅行|りょこう}のほうが{自由|じゆう}に{動|うご}ける。
examples.english: Individual travel allows more freedom of movement.

examples.japanese: {初|はじ}めての{海外|かいがい}は{個人|こじん}{旅行|りょこう}で{行|い}った。
examples.english: My first trip abroad was as an independent traveler.

examples.japanese: ツアーと{個人|こじん}{旅行|りょこう}のどちらがいいか、{目的|もくてき}や{予算|よさん}によって{変|か}わる。
examples.english: Whether a group tour or independent travel is better depends on your purpose and budget.

notes:
Compound of {個人|こじん} (individual; personal) + {旅行|りょこう} (travel; trip). Contrasts with {団体|だんたい}{旅行|りょこう} (group travel) and パッケージツアー (package tour).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {個人|こじん}{旅行|りょこう}で{行|い}く: to go as an independent traveler
- {個人|こじん}{旅行|りょこう}を{計画|けいかく}する: to plan an independent trip
- {個人|こじん}{旅行|りょこう}{向|む}け: suited for individual travelers
- {海外|かいがい}{個人|こじん}{旅行|りょこう}: independent overseas travel

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一人旅|ひとりたび}: solo trip; traveling alone — specifically one person, while {個人|こじん}{旅行|りょこう} can include a couple or small group traveling independently
- {団体|だんたい}{旅行|りょこう}: group travel — the opposite; organized tours with fixed itineraries
- {自由|じゆう}{旅行|りょこう}: free travel — similar meaning, emphasizes the freedom aspect
- バックパッカー{旅行|りょこう}: backpacker travel — a style of budget independent travel
